I am happy to hear from you — whether it is about research, potential
collaborations, data-science consulting, or just to connect. Use the form below and
I will get back to you as soon as I can.

```{=html}
<form class="contact-form" action="https://formsubmit.co/d45b667792dde7689486860a4376f619" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New message from ziafarooq.github.io">
  <input type="hidden" name="_captcha" value="true">
  <input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">
  <input type="hidden" name="_next" value="https://ziaf021.github.io/website/thankyou.html">
  <input type="text" name="_honey" style="display:none">

  <label for="name">Name</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" name="name" placeholder="Your name" required>

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required>

  <label for="message">Message</label>
  <textarea id="message" name="message" placeholder="How can I help?" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
```
